**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 04:12
- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for meal prep ideas and wants to cook more at home while using up all ingredients bought.
- [EVENT] User tried a recipe for Korean bibimbap from a cooking class's online recipe library and found it amazing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Bibimbap is described as a delicious and nutritious meal.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Meal prep is a way to save time, reduce food waste, and ensure healthy meals throughout the week.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested meal prep containers include:
  1. Glass containers (brands: Pyrex, Anchor Hocking, OXO)
  2. Stainless steel containers (brands: LunchBots, S'well, Klean Kanteen)
  3. BPA-free plastic containers (brands: Rubbermaid, Glad, Ziploc)
  4. Mason jars for salads, soups, or overnight oats
  5. Reusable silicone bags (brands: Stasher, Silipint)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider when choosing meal prep containers include size, material, airtight seal, and insulation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested meal prep ideas include:
  - Grilled chicken or salmon with roasted vegetables
  - Quinoa or brown rice bowls with roasted vegetables and protein
  - Lentil or vegetable soups with crusty bread
  - Overnight oats or chia seed pudding with fresh fruits and nuts
  - Stir-fries with favorite protein and mixed vegetables
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended to label and date containers for food storage.
- [PREFERENCE] User is thinking of doing a stir-fry with chicken and mixed veggies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested marinades for chicken stir-fry include:
  1. Soy Sauce and Ginger
  2. Korean-Style Gochujang
  3. Lime and Cilantro
  4. Simple Sesame
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for marinating chicken include refrigerating for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] General tips for marinating chicken include:
  - Always marinate in the refrigerator
  - Acidic ingredients help tenderize the chicken
  - Don't over-marinate
  - Pat chicken dry before cooking
- [PREFERENCE] User is considering adding kimchi to the stir-fry for extra flavor.
